QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Time To Make a Decision
QuestInfo.0: Orchid, the founder of the Black Wings and one of the Black Mage's Commanders, has come to intimidate you into backing down. How will the Resistance deal with a group trying to revive the Black Mage? Inform #p2152004# about these developments immediately.
QuestInfo.1:
The Resistance has met and decided to participate in the Continental Conference, led by Empress #p1101000#. They're not certain they can defeat the Black Mage, even with the other leaders of Maple World at their side, but they know they can't do it on their own.
Go to #bEreve#k and deliver the Resistance's response to Empress #b#p1101000##k.
QuestInfo.2: The Alliance would give you a chance to avenge #p2151005#, wouldn't it?

1.0: Welcome! I've been waiting for you to come. You're from #m310000000#, right? Share your thoughts with me!

yes.0: I welcome your decision. I'll see you at the meeting. We're expecting great results!
